items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him at the Atlanta Jazz Festival. That was a long time ago.

ctx.x: Delroy, I’ve worked with him as well. He seems to work a lot down in Washington.
We talked about – me and Delroy. He was talking about making movies and coming here to do it, because there’s all kinds of movies being made here, because there’s tax credits.
Yeah, they ain’t making too many in San Francisco any more. They’re making them down here. I understand that.
